To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

icosapent-ethyl treatment reduced the primary and key safety endpoints, and all-cause and cardiovascular mortality in US patients, with a particularly strong reduction in all-cause mortality, in REDUCE-IT.

icosapentethyl reduced the risk of the primary composite end point of cardiovascular death, non-fatal myocardial infarctions, non-fatal stroke, coronary revas-cularization, or hospitalizations for unstable angina in US patients, as well as the key secondary end point of cardiovascular mortality, myocardial infarct, or stroke, in US patients.

icosapentethyl reduced the risk of cardiovascular events in US patients by 31% (HR 0.69; 95% CI 0.59-0.80), and that the risk of death in US patients was reduced by 30% (HR 070; 95%CI 0.55-0.90), with a P value for the interaction of 0.02.
